hypotheses.J1_causal_prefix_is_unchanged: Layer-8 residual differences before the edited token are numerically zero within 1e-6 relative norm.
hypotheses.J2_final_position_alone_is_partial: The final-position residual patch has median fidelity below 0.60 to the residual-carrier target on both corpora.
hypotheses.J3_intermediate_positions_carry_signal: Patching positions strictly between edit and final reaches median fidelity at least 0.30 on both corpora.
hypotheses.J4_top4_positions_form_a_compact_route: The four positions with largest individual target projection reach median fidelity at least 0.80 on both corpora.
hypotheses.J5_top8_positions_are_near_sufficient: The top eight positions reach median fidelity at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.J6_position_effects_are_nearly_additive: The signed sum of all seventeen individual-position effects predicts the whole residual-sequence patch at fidelity at least 0.90 on both corpora.
